validityCheck.title: Inverted Slippage Protection

checks.evidence: The bug is in the direction of the comparison (< instead of >), not in user input. No value the user could provide for minRewardTokenSupplied would make the check protect against overpaying.
Owner changing discount rate is normal expected behavior, not reckless. The root cause is the inverted slippage check in claim(), not admin misbehavior.
The inverted comparison is demonstrable in the current code at line 460.

validityCheck.notes: PASS. Genuine code-level bug where slippage protection is directionally inverted. Not admin mistake, not user error, not speculative.

validityCheck.title: All-or-Nothing Claim DoS via Broken Strategy

checks.evidence: Root cause is in the in-scope claim() function which lacks error handling around external withdrawFrom calls.
Strategy reverts are a standard operational risk. The contract already implements token pause functionality, showing awareness of strategy-level issues.

validityCheck.notes: PASS. Real DoS vector in claim() due to lack of error isolation around external calls. Root cause is in-scope, scenario is non-speculative.
